channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tilman Fertitta | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tilman Fertitta from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Tilman Fertitta
item.description:
“I don’t see (team governor) Tilman (Fertitta) ever wanting to take a step back that isn’t strategic,”

Rafael Stone on Tilman Fertitta, May 4, 2026. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Tilman Fertitta, Rafael Stone
item.description:
Kevin Durant:

“To walk in here every day, you see the attention to detail from everybody — not just the leadership of Rafael and Ime and Tilman but everybody who works in here — the level of detail that it takes to become a successful team and franchise. So happy I’m a part of that. I want to keep working to build and show my worth here.”

Kevin Durant on Tilman Fertitta, Rafael Stone, Oct 20, 2025. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Jae'Sean Tate on Tilman Fertitta, Rafael Stone
item.description:
The Rockets will have a $1.78MM team option on Tate for 2022/23.

“I’ve been working really hard this summer and my whole goal is just to prove (general manager) Rafael (Stone), (executive) Patrick and (owner) Tillman Fertitta right,”

Jae'Sean Tate on Tilman Fertitta, Rafael Stone, Aug 29, 2021. Source: Hoops Rumors.

item.title: Gretchen Sheirr on Tilman Fertitta
item.description:
“First, I’d like to thank Tilman, Patrick, and the entire Fertitta Family for their guidance and support, and of course, their trust to help steward the Rockets brand for the city of the Houston,”

Gretchen Sheirr on Tilman Fertitta, May 19, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Tilman Fertitta
item.description:
David Hardisty:Rafael Stone on Tilman Fertitta playing a role on this trade:

“No offense to my boss, but he doesn't really have (a role) on a deal like this.”

Rafael Stone on Tilman Fertitta, Mar 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Paul Silas on Tilman Fertitta, Rafael Stone
item.description:
“I’d like to thank Mr. Fertitta and Rafael for this tremendous opportunity as well as all of the mentors I’ve had over the years, especially my dad, Paul,”

Paul Silas on Tilman Fertitta, Rafael Stone, Oct 30, 2020. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Gersson Rosas, Tilman Fertitta
item.description:
“I'd love to be with the Rockets for life. This obviously solidifies us for a little while. I'm just really thankful to Tilman Fertitta for having the faith in our team. And really, it is about us having a team of people that makes this all work; Coach (Mike) D'Antoni, (vice president) Keith Jones, (vice president) Gersson Rosas, (trainer) Jason Biles, (assistant general manager) Monte McNair, (assistant general manager) Eli Witus, (assistant general manager, Vipers GM) Jimmy Paulis.”

Daryl Morey on Gersson Rosas, Tilman Fertitta, Mar 13, 2019. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Tad Brown on Tilman Fertitta
item.description:
“Tilman is very engaged with it. He and I have been talking about (what can be done.) I'd call it a recognition of the importance of supporting all of our community. We're actively trying to figure out how we can best impact those people affected by it.”

Tad Brown on Tilman Fertitta, May 20, 2018. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Hakeem Olajuwon on Leslie Alexander, Tilman Fertitta
item.description:
Mark Berman:Hakeem Olajuwon on Leslie Alexander selling to @Tilman Fertitta:

“(Les has)been a great owner. I think he passes the ball to the right player”

Hakeem Olajuwon on Leslie Alexander, Tilman Fertitta, Sep 5, 2017. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.
